Sandbox_Automaker_fullbuild_tooltip: If off, built vehicles spawn stripped of parts and needing repair instead of fully finished.
Sandbox_StopThePlantRot_tooltip: Controls over-mature rotting of mature crops
Sandbox_ResetGrowthOnRot_tooltip:
How the crop is handled each time its rot is postponed.
On = Reset to seed-bearing stage and regrow (default); Off = Keep as-is
Sandbox_RotDelay_tooltip:
How many rot checks a mature crop survives before finally rotting.
0 = Never rot (default); N = rots after N postponed checks
